episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Detective Hansaem suspects Ena after she fails to remember anything about her uncle's murder.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: A puzzle piece arrives on the same day as a murder, and Hansaem suspects it's no coincidence.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Ena and Hansaem warily work together to solve the case.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A prime suspect emerges, but things aren't what they seem.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Another puzzle piece arrives, and a new murder case unfolds.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The meaning behind the drawings on the puzzle pieces is uncovered.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Han Saem makes a shocking discovery and becomes unsure of whom to trust.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: As the investigation escalates, new suspects begin to emerge.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: In an unexpected twist, a new suspect is arrested shortly before another victim is discovered. E-na and Han-saem risk it all to try and catch the true killer.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: A stunning truth behind the serial murders is revealed.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: The final puzzle piece arrives. Will the team be able to catch the killer in time?
